Live Sports on TV Today – Your Complete UK TV Listings Guide

Wondering what live sport is on TV today in the UK? Find upcoming matches, sporting events, start times and television channels in one easy-to-use guide. At Live Sport on TV, we make it easier to discover what’s being broadcast across the UK’s leading sports channels and streaming platforms. Whether you’re looking for Premier League football, international rugby, Formula 1, cricket, boxing, tennis or another major sporting event, our regularly updated TV listings help you plan what to watch. Explore today’s live sport, check what’s on tonight or look ahead to the biggest fixtures and competitions coming up this week.

What’s on Live Sports TV Today?

Every day brings a different selection of sporting action, from early-morning international events to afternoon fixtures and late-night championship contests. Our UK live sports TV guide brings together available broadcast schedules, event start times and channel information, helping you find the action that interests you.

Discover televised sport across a wide range of competitions, including:

  • Football: Premier League, Champions League, FA Cup, EFL and international fixtures.
  • Rugby Union: Six Nations, Gallagher PREM, European Champions Cup and international Test matches.
  • Rugby League: Super League, Challenge Cup and international rugby league.
  • Cricket: England internationals, The Ashes, Test cricket, ODIs and T20 competitions.
  • Boxing: Major fight nights, world title contests and pay-per-view events.
  • Darts: PDC World Championship, Premier League Darts and other televised tournaments.
  • Snooker: World Championship, UK Championship, Masters and World Snooker Tour events.
  • Tennis: Wimbledon, Grand Slams, ATP and WTA tournaments.
  • Golf: PGA Tour, DP World Tour, major championships and Ryder Cup.
  • American Football: NFL regular-season fixtures, play-offs and the Super Bowl.
  • Motorsport: Formula 1, MotoGP and other televised racing competitions.

The sports and events displayed depend on the available broadcast schedule.

Find Live Sport on Sky Sports, TNT Sports, BBC and ITV

With sporting events spread across subscription channels, free-to-air television and streaming services, finding the correct broadcaster can sometimes be confusing.

Our sports TV listings for the UK help you identify scheduled coverage across major broadcasters, including:

  • Sky Sports: Football, Formula 1, cricket, golf, darts, tennis and other major competitions.
  • TNT Sports: Premier League football, European club rugby, motorsport and selected international sporting events.
  • BBC Sport: Major championships, international tournaments and selected free-to-air sporting fixtures.
  • ITV Sport: International football, rugby union, horse racing and other televised events.
  • Other TV and streaming services: Selected sports coverage on Channel 4, Channel 5, DAZN, Premier Sports and official streaming platforms.

Broadcasting rights differ between competitions and seasons, so always check the individual event listing for available UK coverage.

Live Sport on TV Tonight and This Week

Looking beyond today’s fixtures? Our guide also helps you discover live sport on TV tonight, tomorrow and throughout the coming week. Whether you’re planning your weekend around a major football match, checking the next Formula 1 race or looking for an evening of boxing or darts, you can explore upcoming broadcasts without visiting multiple channel websites. Use the schedule filters to search by sport, television channel or date. You can also look for a particular team or event to narrow down the listings. All scheduled times are presented for UK viewers, helping you follow both domestic competitions and international sporting events.

Free-to-Air Sport and Subscription TV in the UK

Not every sporting event requires a paid television package. Selected matches, tournaments and championships are broadcast free-to-air on channels such as BBC One, BBC Two, ITV1, Channel 4 and Channel 5. Other competitions are available through subscription services, including Sky Sports, TNT Sports, Premier Sports and DAZN. Some major events may also require a separate pay-per-view purchase. Our listings identify available UK broadcasters so you can check where an event is scheduled to appear before deciding how to watch.

How Our UK Sports TV Guide Works

Live Sport on TV is designed to make finding televised sporting events straightforward. Our listings bring together available schedule information, including event names, participating teams where applicable, start times and television channels. The guide is refreshed regularly as new fixtures and broadcast information become available. You can use the search and filtering options to explore the schedule, whether you’re interested in one particular sport or want to see everything being shown today.
